summary: Strip leading zero coefficients after scalar multiplication in dup_mul_ground and recursively in dmp_mul_ground, restoring canonical dense representations when EX coefficients simplify to zero during clear_denoms. Added regression coverage for zero-polynomial behavior (is_zero, terms_gcd, primitive), degree reduction in each variable, one through three generators, and both convert settings. Reproduced the EX(0) noncanonical result before changes; new regression failed before fix and passed after. Public bin/test run of test_densearith.py, test_densetools.py, and test_polytools.py passed all 241 tests; final regression rerun passed after formatting. Final diff reviewed. No hidden tests accessed.
